Name: Forecaster
Author: remybach
Description:
[b]Install[/b][list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b][list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single-player and multiplayer.
[*]No known mod conflicts.
[*]Works in all languages
[/list]
[b]Config[/b]
You have the following options available in [code]config.json[/code]:

[list]
[*][code]showLuckForecastOnWakeUp[/code] - (default: [code]true[/code]) Whether to show the luck/fortune tooltip when you wake up.
[*][code]showWeatherOnWakeUp[/code] - (default: [code]true[/code]) Whether to show the weather tooltip when you wake up.
[/list][list]
[*][code]initialDelay[/code] - (default: [code]1[/code]) The initial delay in [i]seconds[/i] before the weather forecast showing up.
[*][code]offsetDelay[/code] - (default: [code]2[/code]) The delay between the forecast and the tip notifications.
[*][code]enableShortcutKeys[/code] - (default: [code]false[/code]) Enable the use of the following shortcut keys. Off by default to avoid friction with other mods that might use the same keys.
[*][code]tipKey[/code] - (default [code]OemOpenBrackets[/code] †) The key to press to re-display the tip notification.
[*][code]weatherKey[/code] - (default [code]OemCloseBrackets[/code] †) The key to press to re-display the weather notification.
[/list]
† [i]NB[/i]: Please see the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings#Available_bindings]SMAPI Key Bindings[/url] to customise these.

[b]See also
[/b][list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3040]Readers Digest Mod[/url]﻿﻿[/b]

[/list]

Downloads.Description: Latest version of this mod that now works with SMAPI 3.0 - *massive* thanks to PathosChild for submitting a PR with the changes. What a hero!

Manifest.Name: Forecaster
Manifest.Description: Displays the daily luck message when you wake up so you don't have to check the TV every day.
Manifest.Author: Remy Bach
